hypotheses.title: 3-D Euler-Deconvolution Structural-Index (`SI = 0.0` Contact vs `SI = 1.0` Dike) Solution-Clustering Lineaments
layers: rtp, tmi_hg, tmi_vg, TMI_up150, iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_hg, iso_grav_anom_vg, depth_to_base_surf
hypotheses.signature: Solves Reid et al. (1990) 3-D Euler homogeneity equation `(x - x0) dF/dx + (y - y0) dF/dy + (z - z0) dF/dz = -N (F - B)` in sliding `9x9` windows separately for `N = 0.0` (fault step/contact) and `N = 1.0` (steep hydrothermal dike/breccia pipe), retaining tight horizontal solution clusters (`sigma_xy <= 150 m`, `200 m <= z0 <= 2,500 m`) where `N = 0` gravity solutions co-align with `depth_to_base_surf`.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Directly inverts potential-field derivatives for the 3-D `(x0, y0, z0)` sub-alluvial fault-plane apex rather than evaluating blurred anomalies vertically above deep sources, pinpointing blind intrabasin faults buried under 200-1,500 m of Quaternary basin fill.
hypotheses.confounders: Shallow Miocene basaltic feeder dikes (`N = 1` without basement throw) and noisy ill-conditioned flat-gradient windows.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H29-2 / H30-1 shifted scalar edges heuristically by `depth * cot(dip)` (negative); true least-squares 3-D Euler deconvolution cluster density has never been computed in `GEMSDOE27`.
hypotheses.cost: medium; vectorized `9x9` normal-equations solver on locally hash-pinned bands (~20 min CPU)
hypotheses.data_gate: Existing hash-pinned raster bands; no external download needed.

hypotheses.title: Multi-Scale Wavelet / Gabor Oriented Scarp-Continuity & Drainage-Deflection Shear Tensor on 1 m LiDAR + DEM
hypotheses.signature: quadrature Gabor filterbank (`lambda = 300 m, 600 m, 1,200 m` across 12 azimuths) measuring phase-congruent asymmetric step profiles (Kovesi 1999 step-vs-ridge phase symmetry) paired with systematic transverse stream-channel right/left-lateral deflection angles across Walker Lane strike-slip traces.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Strike-slip and oblique-normal faults in the Walker Lane and Carson Domain produce little vertical throw (missed by relief/slope thresholds) but systematically offset ephemeral desert washes by 20-150 m along strike.
hypotheses.confounders: Eolian longitudinal sand-dune crests in Carson Sink / Winnemucca Dry Lake (symmetric ridge phase = 0, rejected by odd-symmetric step quadrature).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Existing LiDAR channels use local isotropic Laplacian/aspect-coherence or 1-D Radon of Stage-1 probabilities, never odd-symmetric Gabor phase congruence or drainage-deflection shear geometry.
hypotheses.cost: medium; FFT filterbank on locally hash-pinned rasters (~25 min CPU)
hypotheses.data_gate: Existing hash-pinned raster bands; no external download needed.

hypotheses.title: Supervised Seismogenic Slip-Rate & Fault-Recency Transfer Weighting from NBMG INGENIOUS Qfaults Vector Attributes
layers: qfaults_v2_in_footprint.json (`SLIPRATE`, `AGE` strictly derived from `sp.known` visible traces inside each fold), `ieq_n100a15`, `deq_n100a15`, `geod_dilaterate`, `geod_shearrate`
hypotheses.signature: Multi-task / cost-sensitive gradient-boosted training weighting Holocene/Latest-Pleistocene high-slip-rate faults (`> 0.2 mm/yr`) strictly inside `sp.known` training sectors to sharpen geophysical decision boundaries on active dilatational/transtensional fault fabrics.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Unmapped active geothermal faults share the geodetic strain-rate and microseismic signature of young high-slip-rate structures rather than inactive early-Quaternary bedrock scarps that dominate unweighted pixel counts.
hypotheses.confounders: Distributed off-fault aftershock swarms (e.g., 1954 Fairview Peak / Dixie Valley).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: All detectors `B0..H33` treat all `labels.tif` pixels with uniform binary weight `1.0`; slip-rate/recency attribute weighting strictly from visible training traces has never been tested.
hypotheses.validation: Preregister on fresh unused seeds >= 670 with strict per-split visible-only attribute join.
